title: Optimised method for proteomic profiling of human skin
author: Bliss, Heywood, et al.

steps.title: C18 Cleanup of Digest Sample
steps.instruction: Remove salts and lipids by taking 100 µL of the digest solution and performing a clean‑up using ISOLUTE® C18 columns (Biotage).

steps.title: Process and Search MS Data
steps.instruction: Import raw mass‑spectrometry files into Waters ProteinLynx GlobalServer v3.0.1, apply mass correction using the [glutamic acid1]‑fibrinopeptide B delivered via an auxiliary pump, merge the processed spectra, then search the UniProt reviewed human proteome with the specified parameters.

substeps.instruction: Import raw data into Waters ProteinLynx GlobalServer version 3.0.1.
Apply mass correction based on the [glutamic acid1]-fibrinopeptide B mass delivered via an auxiliary pump.
Merge the processed spectra prior to database searching.

Search the UniProt reviewed human proteome with: two fragment ions matched per peptide, four fragment ions per protein, two peptides per protein, one missed cleavage; fixed modification carbamidomethylation of cysteines; dynamic modifications hydroxylation of aspartic acid, lysine, asparagine, proline and oxidation of methionine; false discovery rate set to 4 %.
